title: Benchmark public consultation on price assessment methodologies
gist: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence opened its 2026 annual public consultation (minimum 28 days) on price assessment methodologies covering lithium, nickel, cobalt, natural graphite, synthetic graphite, anode, cathode, black mass and rare earths, giving lithium-ion battery supply chain stakeholders a formal channel to influence the reference prices these commodities trade against.

insights.claim: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence's price assessment methodology for the lithium-ion battery supply chain spans nine categories: lithium, nickel, cobalt, natural graphite, synthetic graphite, anode, cathode, black mass, and rare earths.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: This list maps which battery-chain inputs and intermediates have markets liquid and standardized enough to support a market-leading price benchmark, a proxy for where pricing transparency and indexation already exist across the supply chain.
insights.quote: lithium, nickel, cobalt, natural graphite, synthetic graphite, anode, cathode, black mass and rare earths
insights.locator: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence announces the opening

insights.claim: The inclusion of black mass, a battery-recycling intermediate, alongside primary mined and refined materials in Benchmark's price assessment suite indicates the battery recycling market has matured into a distinct, benchmarkable commodity category.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: A dedicated black mass price benchmark signals recycling volumes and liquidity are now significant enough to price formally, relevant for investors tracking battery recycling economics and secondary supply of critical minerals.
insights.locator: for comment on Benchmark's market-leading price assessment methodologies

insights.claim: Benchmark runs its price assessment methodologies through a rolling annual review process, opening a public consultation period of at least 28 days each year for stakeholders and the public to comment before methodologies are finalized.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Market participants relying on Benchmark's lithium, nickel, cobalt, graphite, and rare earth prices for contracts or indices have a defined annual window each year to influence how those reference prices are calculated.
insights.quote: The consultation period will begin immediately from publication of this article, extending for no less than 28 days from commencement.
insights.locator: The consultation period will begin immediately

insights.claim: Because stakeholders across the lithium-ion battery supply chain can directly submit feedback on Benchmark's price methodologies, companies with commercial contracts indexed to those benchmarks have a formal channel to shape the reference prices that affect their revenue and procurement costs.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Producers, processors, and battery makers with Benchmark-indexed contracts should consider participating in the consultation, since methodology changes can directly move contract pricing outcomes.
